Thanks Naomi — happy to take point on the EU approvals. Lina, great to include you here. Quick notes from my side:

- Minimum from customer for each localized asset: signed consent (English + local language), logo usage spec (SVG + color lockups), and a single-line product descriptor confirmation.
- For France/Germany we should provide translations and ask for a "localized acceptance reply" (short email) rather than a formal contract addendum — keeps turnaround under a week.
- If TechCo's legal asks for redlines, we push to product-marketing review first to avoid legal churn on copy.

Proposed next steps:
1) Naomi: confirm the exact quote lines you plan to publish (short + long).
2) Ben: can you coordinate our localization vendor for FR/DE turnarounds and estimate costs?
3) Lina: once you confirm consent format we’ll prepare localized drafts and a sign-off packet.

I can join the sync next Tuesday (slot in calendar).

—Marissa

Marissa / Naomi — looping in Satoshi from LangPartners (our JP vendor). Quick vendor update:

- FR/DE quick-turn (light localization + post-edit): 2 business days per asset, estimate €450 per language for the one-pager.
- JP needs a native proofreading pass and context review: 4 business days, estimate ¥85,000. We can do a "lite quote" spreadsheet for the homepage teaser and one-pager; attached as JP_lite_quotes.xlsx.
- For QA I recommend a localized-native-check for all languages that will go live in-market (small hourly fee).

Lina — can TechCo confirm whether they prefer translators to work from the English source or provide their own localized phrasing? If they provide local copy, we only need sign-off and will skip vendor costs.
